text: {"298":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle implements allocation and interning of compiler type representations so that they are unique."},"299":{"about":["rustc_middle","rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle owns the compilation-lifetime type arena, while rustc_arena provides its buffer-based allocation mechanism."},"300":{"about":["rustc_arena"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_arena implements arena growth by obtaining additional storage when an existing buffer is exhausted."},"301":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle's type context and its arena use the 'tcx lifetime."},"302":{"about":["rustc_middle"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_middle ties interned type data to the type-context lifetime so it is released when compilation ends."}}
